market_summary: Overall Sentiment: "I think it looks very constructive." The action is what you want to see after a big run, with major indexes either at highs or consolidating tightly. The Nasdaq's follow-through day low, the 50-day line, and the 26,000 level are the primary downside reference points.

AMZN.actionability: Actionable (add on breakout above today's high)
AMZN.technical_action: High handle forming after a powerful earnings gap-up. Clearance of today's high would be an add-on or initiation spot.
AMZN.story: Mega-cap e-commerce/AWS. Accelerating earnings/revenue growth. The AI spending "vibe shift" started here.

TWLO.technical_action: Breakaway gap on earnings Friday, clearing the top of a base. Followed through with additional gains today. RS line just turned up sharply.
TWLO.story: AI-driven communications software. History of being a game-changer earnings mover.

COHR.technical_action: Surged 42-44% last week, getting decisively above the 50-day. Gave back 14% today with violent selling at the open. Still above the 50-day but facing earnings imminently.
COHR.story: Optical networking/AI hardware. High ATR, high risk. The massive run-up before earnings creates a "sprinter before the race" problem.

SMH.technical_action: Down -2.3% today. Stuck below the 50-day line. Many AI stocks are at the 50-day, creating a binary event.
SMH.story: Semiconductor ETF. Ed's rule: "Don't cheat just below a buy point." Wait for a decisive move above the 50-day.

XLE.technical_action: Up nearly 5% on surging oil prices. Technically actionable.
XLE.story: Energy sector ETF. Directly tied to volatile oil headlines; high headline risk.

IGV.technical_action: Up 2.3%, continuing to show money rotation into software. Cleared a handle area, now extended.
IGV.story: Software ETF. The "in vogue" sector right now. Cybersecurity is a leading subsector.

JETS.technical_action: Down -3.4% on the rise in oil prices.
JETS.story: Airline ETF. Ed advises buying only early entries and managing like a swing trade due to geopolitical sensitivity.
